messages:
olivia_research: quick share — ran regional A100 vs H100 sweep for open-llama-7b and mixtral-7b (prefill + decode). small summary below, full logs in CI.

olivia_research: key knobs: batch sizes [1,4,8], seq prefill 1024, decode 512, kernels: triton_fused / flash_attn2, quant: fp16, int8, q4_k_m (nf4-like). regions: us-west2, eu-west1.

olivia_research: short takeaways:
- H100 wins latency p50 prefill by ~18-25% at batch=1.
- Throughput (tok/s) H100 ~1.6x A100 for decode at batch=8, but cost/$ per 1M tokens narrows when using q4_k_m.
- int8 gave unstable output for mixtral; q4_k_m kept quality +2-3% ppl vs int8.

mike_infra: can you paste the numeric rows? even rough numbers help for capacity sizing.

olivia_research: pasted small table (rounded):
```
model         gpu   region     prefill_p50(ms)  decode_tok/s@b8  $/1M tokens (fp16)
open-llama-7b  A100  us-west2   85               22k              $6.2
open-llama-7b  H100  us-west2   66               36k              $5.9
mixtral-7b     A100  eu-west1   92               20k              $6.5
mixtral-7b     H100  eu-west1   70               33k              $6.0

(open-llama q4_k_m @ H100 b8) decode_tok/s -> 41k, $/1M -> $3.4
```

sarah_perf: nice. where did kernel choices move numbers? flash_attn2 vs triton_fused?

olivia_research: flash_attn2 slightly faster for prefill on H100 (~5-7% p50) but triton_fused had more consistent per-token throughput at high concurrency on A100. overall: flash_attn2 + q4_k_m is best combo on H100 for cost and latency.

leo_research: curious about tail latency at b1 decode — any p95/p99 numbers? that matters for API SLA.

olivia_research: p95 decode b1 (open-llama on H100) ~ 230ms, p99 ~ 380ms. A100 p95 ~ 310ms, p99 ~ 560ms. decode path variance reduced with KV-prefetch caching enabled.

dena_ops: for Dedicated sizing, should we assume H100 capacity = 1.6x A100 for mixtral decode workloads? want to update the capacity model.

mike_infra: yes, use 1.55x conservatively plus 15% headroom. also factor region egress differences — eu pricing bumped $/1M tokens by ~8% on our cost calc (network+infra).

ci-bot: Benchmark run uploaded: https://ci.redwood/infer-bench/1859991111 — artifacts: logs, perf traces, flamegraphs, evals. :white_check_mark:

sarah_perf: next steps: add synthetic tail test (sporadic long sequences), and run jittered concurrency to validate p99 with real traffic mix.

olivia_research: will queue follow-ups: 1) long sequence (4k) prefill sweep, 2) kernel microbench to isolate flash vs triton on H100, 3) safety check on q4_k_m sampling consistency across seeds. tagging ops for Dedicated sizing change after we confirm long-seq numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

dena_ops: ack — link sizing ticket when ready and we'll update the capacity planner.
